headline: Names a Maryland Postal Service facility in Upper Marlboro after former county executive Wayne K. Curry.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 9801 Apollo Drive in Upper Marlboro, Maryland, as the "Wayne K. Curry Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or who runs it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 6, 2018.
